subject: Request: Sandbox credit increase for real-time Edge POC - throughput & p95 latency verification
messages:
From: Maria Gonzalez <maria@edgescale.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Thomas Li <thomas.li@edgescale.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox credit request for Edge realtime POC (throughput + p95 latency)

Hi Jordan —

Appreciate the demo last week. We’re planning a focused POC the week of June 15 to validate our real-time inference pipeline against your dedicated sandbox. Scope: 48-hour continuous soak at ~400–600 RPS, 1M tokens/day, target p95 < 200ms on our reference prompt set. We want to run both an optimized quantized variant and an fp16 baseline to compare cost/latency tradeoffs.

We’re coming from a strict timeline — engineering needs results by end of week to sign off on the integration path. Can Redwood provide a one-time sandbox credit top-up (we estimate ~$4.5–6k of usage) and pin the environment so other tenants don’t affect tail latency?

Attached is a short test plan and the prompt set (edgescale_poc_testplan.pdf). Let us know if you need a canary window, or a preferred start time. If procurement needs paperwork, loop them in — risk/compliance is minimal.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzalez
Head of Platform
EdgeScale

--
Attachment: edgescale_poc_testplan.pdf (application/pdf, stub, 220KB)

Jordan — thanks for the heads-up and for attaching the plan. Quick notes after a brief sync with infra:

- We can provision an isolated sandbox slice for a 48-hour window and pin a small dedicated pool to reduce noisy neighbor variance. For a hard isolation guarantee we recommend Redwood Dedicated, but for a one-off soak we can reserve a small pool for the window.
- From the cost estimate and usage pattern you shared, provisional credit of $5,000 from the promo pool is reasonable to cover the run and a small buffer. Approveable on my side provided procurement signs temporary T&Cs and we attach the run to deal RDW-3245.
- Engineer notes: We'll pin the model variant (quantized and fp16) and enable KV cache warm-up; ask EdgeScale to run the warm-up script in the plan in the first 30 minutes to stabilize p95.

If Ben is good with the credit, I can prepare the DocuSign and a short Mutual Action Plan link for both teams. Also suggest we set the test start window to UTC-friendly morning (they said June 15 — propose 2026-06-15 14:00 UTC).

Camila Reyes
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
